purpose: Diagnose intermittent resource preparation spikes without changing GPU resource allocation or upload policy. This is instrumentation, not a freeze repair.

evidence.scope: Same-source controlled Native software-device stair fixture. Parent times include CPU work, driver/scheduling/waits; counters alone do not apportion them. No causal A/B gain or ordinary RTX FPS.

change.optional_thread_accounting: Current thread only; coarse Windows accounting may exceed a short wall interval. Unavailable or regressing thread clocks invalidate all thread values for the packet. Wall minus thread is not reported as a measured wait.
change.enabled: Thread-local binding only around the exact first GPU stair frame in the automated qualification fixture. Ordinary rendering reads a null binding, performs no new diagnostic clock calls and retains no packet.
change.freshness: The existing report ordinal must advance exactly once; exactly one complete valid resource prepare is additionally required. CPU stair frames must have empty packets.
change.storage: Fixed twelve-phase stack packet; scoped binding restored on every exit; failed preparations cannot become completed diagnostics.
change.resource_policy: Every original SDL call, argument and order preserved, including failure/cancel/release paths. No pool, extra upload/readback, GPU call, memory budget change or delay.

held_experiments: 156 identifier and149quad prototypes and all earlier HELD experiments remain unapplied. No retiming, second variant, cap/threshold override.
